65458a83-50b3-40ed-9e9c-d1c624652e77.manualDescription: The Australian Foundation Program is ICMS's stepping stone to higher education, offered through the Aspire Institute. It is designed for students who did not complete Year 12 (or equivalent) and would like entry into an Aspire Institute undergraduate Diploma program or an ICMS Bachelor degree, and is also suitable as an introductory program before a full diploma. Successful completion enables students to enter the first year of an ICMS Bachelor degree, or progress into an Aspire Institute diploma. The program has 10 modules covering English subjects and core business disciplines (Marketing, Mathematics for Business, Business Principles, Accounting, Economics, Computing, Law and Australian Cultural Studies) over 2 trimesters (8 months), delivered on-campus or online at Aspire's City Campus, Sydney.
65458a83-50b3-40ed-9e9c-d1c624652e77.manualCurriculum:
Trimester 1: English 1; Essentials of Computing; Intro to Accounting; Business Principles; The Law in Australia.
Trimester 2: English 2; Australian Cultural Studies; Intro to Service Management; Mathematics for Business; Intro to Economics.
(Source: Aspire Institute's own Australian Foundation Program course page, which lists these 10 modules by trimester with their lecture/tutorial and supervised-study hours.)

8e3fcd32-395c-414d-ad8b-cddb81d4ad9a.manualDescription: Developed by leading industry professionals, ISCA's Diploma of Sports Management (High Performance) provides students with an innovative blend of training, coaching, learning and mentoring, combining elite high-performance sporting fundamentals with state-of-the-art facilities. Students receive career advice, mentoring and professional development, capped by an internship (100 hours of industry training) in their chosen sport. ISCA (International Sport College Australia) is owned, governed and operated by ICMS and delivered across the Northern Beaches, City and Moore Park campuses in Sydney. The diploma runs over three 13-week trimesters, each combining one business unit, one sports management unit and one high-performance unit; students who complete it can articulate into the ICMS Bachelor of Business (Sports Management) with credit transfer of up to 8 subjects.
8e3fcd32-395c-414d-ad8b-cddb81d4ad9a.manualCurriculum:
Business units (choose electives alongside the core): Pathway to Success (BUS101A, core); Global Citizenship (MGT102A) and Management Solutions for a Changing World (MGT101A) and Introduction to Tourism, Hospitality and Events (THE101A) as elective options.
Sports Management units: Sports Psychology, Health and Wellbeing (SPO120A, core); Sports Management Fundamentals (SPO101A, core); Sport Marketing and Media (SPO160A, core); Economics for Sports (ECO150A, core); Socio-Cultural Factors in Sport (SPO102A, elective).
High Performance units: High Performance I (SPO130A), High Performance II (SPO140A), High Performance III (SPO150A) - three physical-preparation-backed specialisation subjects.
Professional Placement (WIL203A): 100 hours of industry training in the final trimester.
(Source: ISCA's own Diploma of Sports Management (High Performance) course page.)
8e3fcd32-395c-414d-ad8b-cddb81d4ad9a.englishOverride: IELTS 6.0 overall band, or TOEFL 69 (or equivalent), stated directly on ISCA's own Diploma of Sports Management (High Performance) course page's Entry Requirements section.

81920ff5-0266-4c91-bc2c-5cd8e044f2a6.manualDescription: The Undergraduate Certificate of Business is one of Aspire Institute's real, currently-taught 12-week online courses (confirmed on Aspire's own Undergraduate Certificate entry-requirements page, which names it alongside its Entrepreneurship, Sports Management and Fashion and Global Brand Management siblings). feb8225a-43f4-4c1d-8abe-d32c2ac3dfe4.manualDescription: ISCA's Undergraduate Certificate of Sport Management (High Performance) is a 'Get Business Qualified in 12 Weeks' course designed for those already working in, or hoping to break into, the sports industry. It gives students a recognised business qualification with a sports-industry focus, and can be used to fast-track further tertiary study such as ISCA's own Diploma of Sports Management (High Performance) or the ICMS Bachelor of Business (Sports Management). It is a domestic-students-only course (not available to international students), delivered on-campus at ICMS's City Campus (also now available online) over 12 weeks across 4 subjects.
feb8225a-43f4-4c1d-8abe-d32c2ac3dfe4.manualCurriculum:
Pathway to Success (BUS101A, 3 credit points, core); Sport Psychology, Health and Wellbeing (SPO120A, 3 credit points, core); High Performance I (SPO130A, 3 credit points, core); Sports Management Fundamentals (SPO101A, 3 credit points, core).
(Source: ISCA's own Undergraduate Certificate of Sport Management (High Performance) course page, Course Structure section.)
